upgrade: a store written by an older kb, refused, then migrated, reindexed and used.

Until the first post-release migration there is no real older schema, so this journey runs a
harnessfake kb one index release ahead (KB_HARNESS_INDEX_PROBE=1: sqlite.ProbeSteps adds the step
index/0002-probe, which clears every body_hash and so declares a reindex). The store's index
database is the frozen baseline fixture (index-v1) holding a few entries and eight logged searches.
kb refuses it and says what to run. migrate up backs the file up first, names the reindex the step
needs, and the search log survives the upgrade.

  $ env KB_HARNESS_INDEX_PROBE=1

  $ kb init --model none --source '*.md'
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model none)

  $ rm .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ mkfixture index-v1 .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: store database $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v1; this kb needs v2. Run: kb migrate up (with the same --store, if any)
  [exit 1]

  $ kb doctor
  ok   config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  ok   sources: 1 configured: "*.md" (files)
  FAIL migrate: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v1, this kb needs v2 (index/0002-probe); run kb migrate up
  ok   model: none: FTS-only index and search
  ok   entries: 1 entries valid
  ok   index.md: absent (optional export)
  ~ ok   version: kb \(version\) at .*
  doctor: 1 failed, 0 warnings
  [stderr] kb doctor: 1 check(s) failed
  [exit 1]

kb version works on any file version, so it runs before the upgrade.

  $ kb version
  kb (version)

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v1 -> v2  1 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0002-probe  test probe: add the table probe and clear every body_hash  [needs kb reindex; effect reindex]
  [exit 1]

The dry run reports the step and the backup it would write, and changes nothing: the status
still says v1 and no backup file exists.

  $ kb migrate up --dry-run
  would migrate store default index: v1 -> v2 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup would be written to $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v1-(time)
    would apply index/0002-probe: test probe: add the table probe and clear every body_hash
  needs: kb reindex (store default: index/0002-probe)

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v1 -> v2  1 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0002-probe  test probe: add the table probe and clear every body_hash  [needs kb reindex; effect reindex]
  [exit 1]

  $ ! exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-*

migrate up backs the file up, applies the step and says the store needs a reindex.

  $ kb migrate up
  migrated store default index: v1 -> v2 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v1-(time)
    applied index/0002-probe: test probe: add the table probe and clear every body_hash
  needs: kb reindex (store default: index/0002-probe)

  $ exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v1-*

  $ kb migrate verify
  ok   location kb.toml
  ok   store default config.toml
  ok   store default kb.sqlite

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION  STATE            PATH
  location       location     v1       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v2       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -        not created yet  $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

With many stores, --all covers every store of the location (and the global location); nothing is pending now.

  $ kb migrate up --all
  everything is up to date

The step cleared every body_hash, so the next reindex rebuilds every entry. The fixture was
indexed with another model, so reindex --all says so on stderr and rebuilds the whole index;
doctor is then clean.

  $ kb reindex --all
  reindexed alpha.md (3 chunks, 0 embedded)
  entries: 1 scanned, 1 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 3; embed calls: 0
  [stderr] embedding model mismatch: this database was indexed with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (4 dims) but this run uses none (0 dims); rebuilding the index

  $ kb doctor
  ok   config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  ok   sources: 1 configured: "*.md" (files)
  ~ ok   driver: fts5 enabled, sqlite [0-9.]+, sqlite-vec v[0-9.]+
  ok   embed_meta: model=none dim=0
  ok   model: none: FTS-only index and search
  ok   entries: 1 entries valid
  ok   db-vs-files: 1 entries in sync
  ok   index.md: absent (optional export)
  ~ ok   version: kb \(version\) at .*
  doctor: 0 failed, 0 warnings

The fixture's eight logged searches are still there: the new search is number 9.

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts --caller claude
  search 9 · 1 hit
  [1] alpha.md › Body
  Alpha › Body
  checkpoint starvation
  search_id=9
